headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and metric values. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all standard text, labels, and table data. Normal tracking.

mono.usage: Use for invoice numbers, transaction IDs, and code snippets.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (2x standard). Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.

container_styles.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-6 rounded-md font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 h-10 px-6 rounded-md font-medium
buttons.accent: bg-accent text-accent-foreground hover:bg-accent/90 h-10 px-6 rounded-md font-medium shadow-md

inputs.default: h-10 bg-white border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary rounded-md
inputs.filled: h-10 bg-slate-50 border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-primary rounded-md

cards.metric: p-6 bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm rounded-lg flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors
cards.job: p-0 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

tables.header: h-12 px-4 text-left align-middle font-medium text-muted-foreground [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px for UI, 2px for active states

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'DM Sans' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.
THEME: Default to Light Mode. Use the 'Industrial Clean' palette. Primary is #0F172A, Accent is #F97316.
LAYOUT: Use the 'Control Room' grid for the main dashboard. High density, but with clear whitespace (p-6) inside containers.
COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Industrial Clean' look. Remove excessive rounding (use rounded-md or rounded-sm).
NAVIGATION: Create a sidebar navigation for desktop with clear icons (Lucide) and a bottom navigation for mobile.
DATA: Use Recharts for all charts. Style them with the primary and accent colors.
INTERACTIONS: Add hover states to all interactive elements. Use 'transform hover:-translate-y-1' for cards.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast ratios. Use 'data-testid' for all interactive elements.
IMAGES: Use the provided image URLs for crew profiles, job sites, and equipment. Do NOT use placeholders.
FORBIDDEN: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle patterns.
FORBIDDEN: Do not use 'Inter' font. Use 'DM Sans' instead.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make it look like a premium, custom-built tool.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
